name: Nurella Beauty Lounge
summary: Nurella Beauty Lounge is a beauty and aesthetics lounge offering facial aesthetics, advanced skin treatments, collagen biostimulation, skin boosters, laser, permanent makeup and nail services. Every treatment begins with a personalized consultation and a plan built around the client's features, skin needs and desired results.
description: Nurella Beauty Lounge is a destination dedicated to advanced aesthetics, skin rejuvenation and beauty. The lounge offers ten categories of treatment, from facial aesthetics and non-surgical contouring to collagen biostimulation, skin boosters, advanced skin treatments, laser, permanent makeup and nails.

Every treatment starts with a personalized consultation. There is no fixed menu applied to every client: the treatment plan is designed around your facial proportions, skin condition and the result you are looking for.
The guiding principle is "Enhance, never change." Nurella aims for natural, elegant results that respect your individuality rather than a standardized look.
positioning: Natural results, refined beauty, personalized care.
specialties: Facial aesthetics and non-surgical facial contouring
Collagen biostimulation and regenerative skin treatments
Skin boosters, mesotherapy and rejuvenation protocols
Advanced skin treatments for texture, acne marks and pigmentation
Laser treatments, including laser hair removal
Permanent makeup (microblading, nano blading, lip blush, eyeliner)
Manicure, pedicure and gel nail services
differentiators: Every treatment begins with a personalized consultation rather than a fixed package.
The stated goal is natural enhancement — "Enhance, never change" — not a standardized look.
Facial aesthetics, regenerative skin treatments, laser, permanent makeup and nails are offered under one roof, so a plan can combine categories.
Appointments are requested online and confirmed by the lounge, so every booking is reviewed rather than auto-accepted.
bookingSteps: Choose a treatment from the online treatment menu.
Pick a date and time from the lounge's live availability.
Submit the request — it stays pending until the lounge reviews it.
Receive a confirmation (or a proposed alternative time) from the lounge.
Attend the consultation, where the treatment plan and price are confirmed before anything is carried out.
pricingPolicy: Nurella does not publish fixed treatment prices. Because plans are personalized, the price is confirmed during the consultation, before any treatment is carried out. A price is shown on a treatment page only when the lounge has set one for that specific treatment.
